Title: LIMINAL PANDA GTPDoor v3 - md5
Description: MD5 of LIMINAL PANDA GTPDoor v3 (GTP-U-Door), the Linux implant that hides command-and-control inside GTP-U and uses libpcap for packet capture. Telco-specific. Source: Enea – The Enemy Within: Tracking LIMINAL PANDA and SilentAir through Mobile Networks https://www.enea.com/insights/the-enemy-within-tracking-liminal-panda-and-silentair-through-mobile-networks/
RecommendedActions: Block and quarantine the file on Linux hosts, especially telco and signalling nodes, and investigate any process whose MD5 matches.
